Sticky Wrist Wrap.name: Sticky Wrist Wrap
Sticky Wrist Wrap.description: The user shoots a short strip around one nearby person's wrists and fixes it to itself or a firm surface. Their hands stay bound until they tear the tape free or someone cuts it; held back, the wrap leaves room to avoid injury. The user needs a clear line to the wrists, and a powerful target can break the strip. Strain: light.
